feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: Australia's northern heatwave escalated to extreme warnings across Western Australia and the Northern Territory
entry.summary: The Bureau of Meteorology raised extreme heatwave warnings across Western Australia's Kimberley, Pilbara and North Interior districts, with severe conditions in Gascoyne and South Interior, while the Northern Territory's Top End and central districts carry severe-to-extreme warnings. — Sources: Bureau of Meteorology heatwave warnings, via SBS News and Western Australian regional press, 18-19 October 2026

entry.title: The United States' run of out-of-season autumn heat records ended as a cold front swept through
entry.summary: More than 270 daily temperature records were broken or tied in the two weeks to 19 October, including 183 in a single day on 13 October across 21 states. — Sources: NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network Daily records, via weatheronthisday.com · FOX Weather, 16-19 October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze broke its two-week plateau in the very unhealthy band
entry.summary: Singapore's 24-hour PSI fell steadily through 19 October, with the west dropping from 161 at midnight to 122 at noon and the central region from 128 to 103, down sharply from 227 and 180 at the same point the day before. — Sources: National Environment Agency, real-time PSI data, 19 October 2026
